question: Why Are NC Contacts Used for Emergency Stop Push Buttons?
body_html:
Emergency stop push buttons use normally closed (NC) contacts because the circuit carries current in the healthy state, so pressing the button opens it, drops the contactor coil and stops the machine without relying on any software.

It is also fail safe. A broken wire, loose terminal or failed contact opens the circuit just like pressing the button, so the machine stops and the fault is revealed. With an NO contact, a broken wire would stay hidden until a real emergency.
